title: Green 2-in-1 Garden Folding Stool Kneeler, 300LBS Capacity & Built-in Tool Pouch
body_html:
• Versatile Usage: You can use this product as a lightweight handy garden seat or turn it upside down as a kneeler, a nice gift for people who enjoy gardening.
• Folding Design: This stool kneeler can be easily folded into a compact size for convenient storage and transportation. And there is a handle makes it could be moved from room to room as you like.
• Durable Steel Frame: Made of deformable and firm steel, this stool is heavy-duty enough to hold people up to 300Lbs. Powder coating tubes prolong the lifespan of this bench.
• Comfortable Seat: Features a thick EVA seat for better comfort, which would not make you feel pain or get injured while kneeling on it. And the easy-grasping handle design is for convenient movement when you are sitting on the stool.
• Comes with Tools Pouch: Tools pouch is not only for holding tools but also provides space for keeping seeds and fertilizer and organized.

Color:Green
Material:Sturdy Steel Tube, Durable Foam and Plastic
Weight Capacity:300 lbs
Item Weight:5.7 lbs
Dimension:23/24" x 11" x 19.5"(W x D x H)
Folded Dimension:23.5/24" x 11" x 5"(L x W x H)
Seat Pad Size;16" x 8" (L x W)
Is Assembly Required:Yes
